question: Which b-tagging algorithm was used, at what efficiency working point, and what rejection factor did it give against light-quark and gluon jets?
expect: MV1, 70% efficiency, rejection about 140 (about 5 against charm) (sec. 3)
rendered:
The b-tagging algorithm used was the MV1 algorithm, a multivariate discriminant making use of track impact parameters and reconstructed secondary vertices. 

It was used at a tagging working point corresponding to a 70% efficiency for tagging b-quark jets from top decays in t¯t events. 

The rejection factor against light-quark and gluon jets was about 140, and against jets originating from charm quarks was about five.
